reason: Being able to look at the actual set, check it in person and only pay on collection takes most of the risk away, and the fit refund covers my PCD worry. If the set for my car is there and looks clean I'd go and see it, but I wouldn't commit until I'd seen the wheels myself.
objection: Refurbished paint can peel or the wheel can fail again, and they're a brand new seller with no reviews, so I only have their word on the crack check.
